sloka: भारावतरणार्थं हि नरनारायणावुभौ ।उत्पत्स्येते महावीर्यौ कलौ युग उपस्थिते ।। ७.५३.२२ ॥
transliteration: bhārāvataraṇārthaṁ hi naranārāyaṇāvubhau ।utpatsyete mahāvīryau kalau yuga upasthite ।। 7.53.22 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, both Nara and Narayana, greatly powerful, will be born for the purpose of alleviating the earth's burden when the Kali Yuga has arrived.
